steam.store_details: Delisted from Steam in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale. OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) distributes a free, Epic-authorized copy of the full game.
steam.patches: OldUnreal's v227 patch adds a modern 'ALAudio' sound renderer, a strong alternative worth trying. It replaces the game's original EAX sound, so use one or the other.

gog.store_details: Delisted from GOG in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale. OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) distributes a free, Epic-authorized copy of the full game.
gog.patches: OldUnreal's v227 patch adds a modern 'ALAudio' sound renderer, a strong alternative worth trying. It replaces the game's original EAX sound, so use one or the other.

audio_fixes.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Unreal only plays EAX reverb when its hardware 3D sound, reverb and spatial sound options are all on.
